verdict.rationale: Yapily's Data API retrieves end-customers' bank accounts, balances and transactions. That is the core open-banking service, not a way for a Yapily user to export their own platform data (configurations, consents, payment history, webhook setups) in open formats and leave. The evidence documents no bulk export, data-portability or offboarding capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
